name: no-01
words: 今有上禾三秉，中禾二秉，下禾一秉，實三十九斗，上禾二秉，中禾三秉，下禾一秉，實三十四斗，上禾一秉，中禾二秉，下禾三秉，實二十六斗，問上中下禾實一秉各幾何
text:
No. 8.1
% Sibu congkan pp. 2-6 (statement p. 2, answer and procedure pp. 3-6; Liu Hui's commentary throughout)
"今有上禾三秉，中禾二秉，下禾一秉，實三十九斗，上禾二秉，中禾三秉，下禾一秉，實三十四斗，上禾一秉，中禾二秉，下禾三秉，實二十六斗，問上中下禾實一秉各幾何"
% Suppose 3 bundles of top-grade grain, 2 of middle-grade and 1 of low-grade yield 39 dou of grain;
% 2 top, 3 middle and 1 low yield 34 dou; 1 top, 2 middle and 3 low yield 26 dou.
% How much grain does one bundle of each grade yield?
"荅曰，上禾一秉九斗四分斗之一，中禾一秉四斗四分斗之一，下禾一秉二斗四分斗之三"
% Answer: one bundle of top grain, 9 1/4 dou; of middle, 4 1/4 dou; of low, 2 3/4 dou.
"術曰，置上禾三秉，中禾二秉，下禾一秉，實三十九斗，於右方，中左禾列如右方，以右行上禾徧乘中行，而以直除，又乘其次，亦以直除，然以中行中禾不盡者，徧乘左行，而以直除，左方下禾不盡者，上爲法，下爲實，實卽下禾之實，求中禾，以法乘中行下實，而除下禾之實，餘如中禾秉數而一，卽中禾之實，求上禾，亦以法乘右行下實，而除下禾中禾之實，餘如上禾秉數而一，卽上禾之實，實皆如法，各得一斗"
% The image reads 而以直除 / 亦以直除 / 而以直除 (pp. 3-4); the Wikisource text drops 直 each time.
% in 斗
Things 上禾 中禾 下禾 實
Set right   3 2 1 39          "置上禾三秉，中禾二秉，下禾一秉，實三十九斗，於右方"
Set middle  2 3 1 34          "中左禾列如右方"
Set left    1 2 3 26
Multiply middle by the head of right.            "以右行上禾徧乘中行"
Take right from middle until the head is gone.   "而以直除"
Multiply left by the head of right.              "又乘其次"
Take right from left until the head is gone.     "亦以直除"
% 其次 read as the next column, the left (so Liu Hui: 復去左行首).
Multiply left by the 中禾 of middle.             "然以中行中禾不盡者，徧乘左行"
Take middle from left until the head is gone.    "而以直除"
% Liu Hui: 亦令兩行相乘去行之中禾也. No figure for any column is stated by
% the text, Liu Hui, or Dai Zhen, so there are no Gives lines.
% Dai Zhen (訂訛 p. 36) reads each 徧乘 ... 直除 as mutual: 以右行上禾徧乘中行，
% 復以中行上禾徧乘右行，然後可相對減 (i.e. `crosswise`), the text naming only one
% multiplication 古人文省. He gives no figures.
Solve.
Answer 9 1/4, 4 1/4, 2 3/4

name: no-02
words: 今有上禾七秉，損實一斗，益之下禾二秉，而實十斗，下禾八秉，益實一斗，與上禾二秉，而實十斗，問上下禾實一秉各幾何
text:
No. 8.2
% Sibu congkan pp. 6-7
"今有上禾七秉，損實一斗，益之下禾二秉，而實十斗，下禾八秉，益實一斗，與上禾二秉，而實十斗，問上下禾實一秉各幾何"
% Suppose 7 bundles of top-grade grain, their yield lessened by 1 dou, with 2 bundles of low-grade
% grain added, yield 10 dou; 8 bundles of low-grade grain, their yield increased by 1 dou, with
% 2 bundles of top-grade, yield 10 dou. How much does one bundle of each grade yield?
"荅曰，上禾一秉實一斗五十二分斗之十八，下禾一秉實五十二分斗之四十一"
% Answer: one bundle of top grain yields 1 dou and 18/52 of a dou; one of low grain, 41/52 of a dou.
% (十 / 八 of the first answer is broken across pp. 6-7.)
"術曰，如方程，損之曰益，益之曰損，損實一斗者，其實過十斗也，益實一斗者，其實不滿十斗也"
% in 斗
% The procedure says only 如方程, with 損之曰益，益之曰損: the 斗 taken off the first
% condition is added to its 實 (10 + 1), and the 斗 put on the second is taken from
% its 實 (10 - 1). Each condition is a column, the first the right.
Things 上禾 下禾 實
Set right  7 2 11        "損之曰益"
Set left   2 8 9         "益之曰損"
Gives right 7 2 11       "今按實云上禾七秉，下禾二秉，實十一斗"
Gives left  2 8 9        "上禾二秉，下禾八秉，實九斗也"
% Liu Hui's commentary states both columns; the Gives lines record it.
Solve.
Answer 1 18/52, 41/52

name: no-03
words: 今有上禾二秉，中禾三秉，下禾四秉，實皆不滿斗，上取中，中取下，下取上，各一秉而實滿斗，問上中下禾實一秉各幾何
text:
No. 8.3
% Sibu congkan pp. 7-8 (the 正負術, which follows on pp. 9-11, is not part of this page)
"今有上禾二秉，中禾三秉，下禾四秉，實皆不滿斗，上取中，中取下，下取上，各一秉而實滿斗，問上中下禾實一秉各幾何"
% Suppose 2 bundles of top-grade grain, 3 of middle-grade and 4 of low-grade each yield less than
% a dou. If the top takes one bundle of the middle, the middle one of the low, and the low one of
% the top, each yields a full dou. How much does one bundle of each grade yield?
"荅曰，上禾一秉實二十五分斗之九，中禾一秉實二十五分斗之七，下禾一秉實二十五分斗之四"
% Answer: one bundle of top grain yields 9/25 dou; of middle, 7/25 dou; of low, 4/25 dou.
"術曰，如方程，各置所取，以正負術入之"
"正負術曰，同名相除，異名相益，正無入負之，負無入正之，其異名相除，同名相益，正無入正之，負無入負之"
% The rule of signs (pp. 9-10), which follows this problem. When taking a column from another:
% like signs subtract, unlike signs add; a positive with nothing opposite becomes negative, a
% negative with nothing opposite becomes positive. When adding: unlike signs subtract, like signs
% add; a positive with nothing opposite stays positive, a negative stays negative.
% jiuzhang uses it as signed arithmetic. Liu Hui's commentary on it states no figures.
% in 斗
% Set as Liu Hui says: 置上禾二秉爲右行之上，中禾三秉爲中行之中，下禾四秉爲左行之下，
% 所取一秉及實一斗各從其位.
Things 上禾 中禾 下禾 實
Set right   2 1 0 1      "置上禾二秉爲右行之上"
Set middle  0 3 1 1      "中禾三秉爲中行之中"
Set left    1 0 4 1      "下禾四秉爲左行之下，所取一秉及實一斗各從其位"
Solve.
Answer 9/25, 7/25, 4/25

name: no-04
words: 今有上禾五秉，損實一斗一升，當下禾七秉，上禾七秉，損實二斗五升，當下禾五秉，問上下禾實一秉各幾何
text:
No. 8.4
% Sibu congkan pp. 11-12
"今有上禾五秉，損實一斗一升，當下禾七秉，上禾七秉，損實二斗五升，當下禾五秉，問上下禾實一秉各幾何"
% Suppose the yield of 5 bundles of top-grade grain, lessened by 1 dou 1 sheng, equals that of 7
% bundles of low-grade; the yield of 7 bundles of top-grade, lessened by 2 dou 5 sheng, equals that
% of 5 bundles of low-grade. How much does one bundle of each grade yield?
"荅曰，上禾一秉五升，下禾一秉二升"
% Answer: one bundle of top grain, 5 sheng; one of low grain, 2 sheng.
"術曰，如方程，置上禾五秉正，下禾七秉負，損實一斗一升正，次置上禾七秉正，下禾五秉負，損實二斗五升正，以正負術入之"
% The image (p. 12) reads 以正負術入之; the Wikisource text has 八之.
% in 升: 1 斗 is 10 升
Things 上禾 下禾 實
Set right  5 -7 11       "置上禾五秉正，下禾七秉負，損實一斗一升正"
Set left   7 -5 25       "次置上禾七秉正，下禾五秉負，損實二斗五升正"
Solve.                   "以正負術入之"
Answer 5, 2

name: no-05
words: 今有上禾六秉，損實一斗八升，當下禾十秉，下禾十五秉，損實五升，當上禾五秉，問上下禾實一秉各幾何
text:
No. 8.5
% Sibu congkan pp. 12-13
"今有上禾六秉，損實一斗八升，當下禾十秉，下禾十五秉，損實五升，當上禾五秉，問上下禾實一秉各幾何"
% Suppose the yield of 6 bundles of top-grade grain, lessened by 1 dou 8 sheng, equals that of 10
% bundles of low-grade; the yield of 15 bundles of low-grade, lessened by 5 sheng, equals that of 5
% bundles of top-grade. How much does one bundle of each grade yield?
"荅曰，上禾一秉實八升，下禾一秉實三升"
% Answer: one bundle of top grain yields 8 sheng; one of low grain, 3 sheng.
"術曰，如方程，置上禾六秉正，下禾十秉負，損實一斗八升正，次置上禾五秉負，下禾十五秉正，損實五升正，以正負術入之"
% in 升: 1 斗 is 10 升
Things 上禾 下禾 實
Set right  6 -10 18      "置上禾六秉正，下禾十秉負，損實一斗八升正"
Set left   -5 15 5       "次置上禾五秉負，下禾十五秉正，損實五升正"
Solve.                   "以正負術入之"
Answer 8, 3

name: no-06
words: 今有上禾三秉，益實六斗，當下禾十秉，下禾五秉，益實一斗，當上禾二秉，問上下禾實一秉各幾何
text:
No. 8.6
% Sibu congkan pp. 13-14
"今有上禾三秉，益實六斗，當下禾十秉，下禾五秉，益實一斗，當上禾二秉，問上下禾實一秉各幾何"
% Suppose the yield of 3 bundles of top-grade grain, increased by 6 dou, equals that of 10 bundles
% of low-grade; the yield of 5 bundles of low-grade, increased by 1 dou, equals that of 2 bundles
% of top-grade. How much does one bundle of each grade yield?
"荅曰，上禾一秉實八斗，下禾一秉實三斗"
% Answer: one bundle of top grain yields 8 dou; one of low grain, 3 dou.
"術曰，如方程，置上禾三秉正，下禾十秉負，益實六斗正，次置上禾二秉負，下禾五秉正，益實一斗正，以正負術入之"
% in 斗
% The signs are set as the procedure states them, 益實 正 in both columns (image p. 14
% reads 正 after 益實六斗 and after 益實一斗; re-read, it says so). The Wikisource
% text of this scan agrees (正, 正). The punctuated Wikisource text of another edition
% (jiuzhang.wiki) reads 益實六斗負 ... 益實一斗負; with those signs the board gives 8, 3.
% Not changed: this page follows the scan. jiuzhang finds -8, -3 (法 -5, 實 40 15).
Things 上禾 下禾 實
Set right  3 -10 6       "置上禾三秉正，下禾十秉負，益實六斗正"
Set left   -2 5 1        "次置上禾二秉負，下禾五秉正，益實一斗正"
Solve.                   "以正負術入之"
Answer 8, 3

name: no-07
words: 今有牛五羊二直金十兩，牛二羊五直金八兩，問牛羊各直金幾何
text:
No. 8.7
% Sibu congkan p. 15
"今有牛五羊二直金十兩，牛二羊五直金八兩，問牛羊各直金幾何"
% Now there are 5 oxen and 2 sheep, worth 10 liang of gold; 2 oxen and 5 sheep, worth 8 liang of gold. How much gold is one ox, and one sheep, worth?
% The scan has 直 (worth) three times; the Wikisource text (卷第八.paged.txt) leaves it out each time.
"荅曰牛一直金一兩二十一分兩之十三，羊一直金二十一分兩之二十"
% Answer: one ox is worth 1 13/21 liang of gold; one sheep is worth 20/21 liang of gold.
"術曰如方程"
% Unit: 兩 (liang) of gold.
% The text says only 如方程: each condition is a column, in the order of the statement;
% the first (牛五羊二直金十兩) is the right-hand column, the second (牛二羊五直金八兩) the left.
Things 牛 羊 金
Set right  5 2 10
Set left   2 5 8
Solve.
Answer 1 13/21, 20/21

% Liu Hui's commentary works the board by making the heads equal (齊同), and states its figures.
"假令爲同齊頭位爲牛左右行相乘定"
% The board set again as the statement gives it, for Liu Hui's working.
Set right  5 2 10
Set left   2 5 8
Multiply right by the head of left.                "左右行相乘"
Multiply left by 5.                                % by the head right had before it was multiplied
Gives right 10 4 20                                "更置牛十羊四直金二十兩"
Gives left  10 25 40                               "左行牛十羊二十五直金四十兩"
"牛數等同金多二十兩者羊差二十一使之然也"
Take right from left.                              "以少行減多行"
Gives left  0 21 20                                "則牛數盡惟羊與金之數見可得而知也"
"以小推大雖四五行不異也"

name: no-08
words: 今有賣牛二羊五以買十三豕有餘錢一千，賣牛三豕三以買九羊錢適足，賣羊六豕八以買五牛錢不足六百，問牛羊豕價各幾何
text:
No. 8.8
% Sibu congkan pp. 16-17
"今有賣牛二羊五以買十三豕有餘錢一千，賣牛三豕三以買九羊錢適足，賣羊六豕八以買五牛錢不足六百，問牛羊豕價各幾何"
% Now someone sells 2 oxen and 5 sheep to buy 13 pigs, and has 1000 cash over; sells 3 oxen and 3 pigs to buy 9 sheep, and the cash is just enough; sells 6 sheep and 8 pigs to buy 5 oxen, and is 600 cash short. What is the price of an ox, a sheep and a pig?
"荅曰牛價一千二百，羊價五百，豕價三百"
% Answer: an ox costs 1200, a sheep 500, a pig 300.
"術曰如方程置牛二羊五正豕十三負餘錢數正次置牛三正羊九負豕三正次置牛五負羊六正豕八正不足錢負以正負術入之"
% Unit: 錢 (cash).
Things 牛 羊 豕 錢
Set right   2  5 -13 1000     "置牛二羊五正豕十三負餘錢數正"
Set middle  3 -9   3    0     "次置牛三正羊九負豕三正"   % 錢適足: the middle 實 is empty
Set left   -5  6   8 -600     "次置牛五負羊六正豕八正不足錢負"
Solve.                        "以正負術入之"
Answer 1200, 500, 300
% Liu Hui's note on the middle column (此中行買賣相折錢適足…) supposes a working (設欲以此行如方程法先令牛二徧乘左行而以右行直除之) but states no figure for this board.
% Dai Zhen's working of the board, with its figures, is corpus/dai-zhen-08.jz.

name: dai-zhen-08
words: 此注訛脫不分曉據術意應列三行
text:
No. 8.8
% Dai Zhen, 九章算術卷八訂訛, Sibu congkan pp. 41-42: his working of Problem 8 by cross-multiplication (互乘).
"此注訛脫不分曉據術意應列三行"
% Unit: 錢 (cash). The board as the procedure sets it (corpus/no-08.jz).
Things 牛 羊 豕 錢
Set right   2  5 -13 1000
Set middle  3 -9   3    0
Set left   -5  6   8 -600
Take middle from right crosswise.   "先令右行牛二徧乘中行復令中行牛三徧乘右行而以直除"
% The signs he gives (羊正, 豕負, 錢正) are those of 3 x right less 2 x middle: the middle is taken from the right.
Gives right 0 33 -45 3000           "得羊三十三正豕四十五負餘錢三千正"
"此同名相除異名相益正無入負之負無入正之也"
% Dai Zhen uses the right column as first set again (右行牛二) in the next step, and later lays the two
% results out as a new pair (重列爲左右兩行). `Take` writes its result over the column it takes from,
% so the result is moved to the middle and the right is set again as it stood. These two Set lines are
% the transcriber's, not Dai Zhen's.
Set middle  0 33 -45 3000
Set right   2  5 -13 1000
Take right from left crosswise.     "次令右行牛二徧乘左行復令左行牛五徧乘右行而以直除"
% 牛 heads of opposite sign (2 and -5): 2 x left less -5 x right, i.e. the two are added (異名相除).
Gives left  0 37 -49 3800           "得羊三十七正豕四十九負餘錢三千八百正"
"此異名相除同名相益正無入正之負無入負之也"
"重列爲左右兩行"
% His new right is the middle here (羊三十三), his new left the left (羊三十七).
Take middle from left crosswise.    "先令右行羊三十三徧乘左行復令左行羊三十七徧乘右行而以直除"
Gives left  0 0 48 14400            "得豕四十八正以爲法錢一萬四千四百正爲實"
Solve.                              "實如法而一得豕價三百轉減而上得羊價五百牛價一千二百"
Answer 1200, 500, 300
"此亦同名相除異名相益正無入負之負無入正之也中行下實虛缺本無庸論葢注文傳寫失眞後人又妄加改竄遂不可通"

name: no-09
words: 今有五雀六燕集稱之衡，雀俱重燕俱輕，一雀一燕交而處衡適平，并燕雀重一斤，問燕雀一枚各重幾何
text:
No. 8.9
% Sibu congkan pp. 17-18
"今有五雀六燕集稱之衡，雀俱重燕俱輕，一雀一燕交而處衡適平，并燕雀重一斤，問燕雀一枚各重幾何"
% Now 5 sparrows and 6 swallows are gathered on the pans of a balance: the sparrows together are heavier, the swallows together lighter. Exchange one sparrow and one swallow, and the balance is level. Swallows and sparrows together weigh 1 jin. How much does one swallow, and one sparrow, weigh?
"荅曰雀重一兩十九分兩之十三，燕重一兩十九分兩之五"
% Answer: a sparrow weighs 1 13/19 liang; a swallow 1 5/19 liang.
"術曰如方程交易質之各重八兩"
% Unit: 兩 (liang); 1 斤 is 16 兩, so each pan, level, holds 8 兩.
% The procedure says only to exchange them and that each pan weighs 8 兩. The pans after the exchange are
% columns: the sparrows' pan (五雀 less one sparrow, with one swallow: 四雀一燕) is the right-hand column,
% the swallows' pan (六燕 less one swallow, with one sparrow: 一雀五燕) the left. Liu Hui reads the board
% so: 此四雀一燕與一雀五燕衡適平并重一斤故各八兩列兩行程數 (his working: corpus/liu-hui-09.jz).
Things 雀 燕 重
Set right  4 1 8      "交易質之各重八兩"
Set left   1 5 8
Solve.
Answer 1 13/19, 1 5/19

name: dai-zhen-09
words: 此卽末條所言新術
text:
No. 8.9
% Dai Zhen, 九章算術卷八訂訛, Sibu congkan p. 43: Liu Hui's 異術 for Problem 9 worked out.
% Unit: 兩.
"此卽末條所言新術"
Things 雀 燕 重
Set right  4 1 8
Set left   1 5 8
% 以下實俱重八兩徧乘上雀燕: each column is multiplied by the other's 實, which is 8 in both. He names only
% the 雀 and 燕 figures (右雀三十二, 左雀八, 左燕四十, 右燕八), so no Gives is written for the multiplied columns.
Multiply right by the 重 of left.                  "以下實俱重八兩徧乘上雀燕"
Multiply left by 8.                                % the 重 of the right as it was set, 八兩 (俱重八兩)
Take left from right.                              "以左雀八減右雀三十二餘二十四以右燕八減左燕四十餘三十二"
% 雀 24 over on the right, 燕 32 over on the left: as a column, 雀 24 正 and 燕 32 負; the 實 is gone,
% which he does not say in figures (是爲二物): the 0 is the transcriber's.
Gives right 24 -32 0                               "是爲二物正負相借"
Reduce right.                                      "因而約之"
Gives right 3 -4 0                                 "雀得三燕得四乃三雀當四燕也"
"對易其數卽雀率重四而燕率重三"
% The rates 4 and 3 are not a column, and `Rates` cannot check them here (see corpus/liu-hui-09.jz).
"注於此突入異術幾不解其所謂"

name: liu-hui-09

text:
No. 8.12
% Sibu congkan pp. 21-22
"今有武馬一匹中馬二匹下馬三匹皆載四十石至阪皆不能上，武馬借中馬一匹，中馬借下馬一匹，下馬借武馬一匹，乃皆上，問武中下馬一匹各力引幾何"

If the strong horse borrows one middling horse, the middling horses one poor horse, and the poor horses one strong horse, then all get up. How much can one strong, one middling and one poor horse each pull?

name: no-13
words: 今有五家共井，甲二綆不足如乙一綆，乙三綆不足如丙一綆，丙四綆不足如丁一綆，丁五綆不足如戊一綆，戊六綆不足如甲一綆，各得所不足一綆皆逮，問井深綆長各幾何
text:
No. 8.13
% Sibu congkan pp. 22-23
"今有五家共井，甲二綆不足如乙一綆，乙三綆不足如丙一綆，丙四綆不足如丁一綆，丁五綆不足如戊一綆，戊六綆不足如甲一綆，各得所不足一綆皆逮，問井深綆長各幾何"
% Five households share a well. Two of A's ropes fall short of the water by one of B's ropes; three of B's
% fall short by one of C's; four of C's by one of D's; five of D's by one of E's; six of E's by one of A's.
% Each, given the one rope it lacks, just reaches. How deep is the well, and how long is each rope?
"荅曰井深七丈二尺一寸，甲綆長二丈六尺五寸，乙綆長一丈九尺一寸，丙綆長一丈四尺八寸，丁綆長一丈二尺九寸，戊綆長七尺六寸"
% Answer: the well is 7 zhang 2 chi 1 cun deep (721 cun); A's rope 2 zhang 6 chi 5 cun (265 cun);
% B's 1 zhang 9 chi 1 cun (191); C's 1 zhang 4 chi 8 cun (148); D's 1 zhang 2 chi 9 cun (129); E's 7 chi 6 cun (76).
"術曰如方程以正負術入之"
% The text does not say how to set the board. Six unknowns, five conditions: the depth is taken as the
% 實 of every column ("名各一逮井": each column comes to one well-depth), and the five ropes are the things.
% Each condition "X n 綆不足如 Y 一綆" is read n·X + 1·Y = 1 depth, and set as a column, the first
% condition (甲, 乙) as the right-hand column, the rest leftwards in the order the text gives them.
% Unit: one well-depth. The answer is then a set of rates (率): the 法 is the depth, the 實s the ropes.
Things 甲 乙 丙 丁 戊 實
Set right 2 1 0 0 0 1     "甲二綆不足如乙一綆"
Set 2nd   0 3 1 0 0 1     "乙三綆不足如丙一綆"
Set 3rd   0 0 4 1 0 1     "丙四綆不足如丁一綆"
Set 4th   0 0 0 5 1 1     "丁五綆不足如戊一綆"
Set left  1 0 0 0 6 1     "戊六綆不足如甲一綆"
Solve.
% The text's answer, in 寸: the depth 721 as the 法, then the ropes 甲 to 戊.
Rates 721 265 191 148 129 76

% Liu Hui's commentary (small characters after 術曰, p. 23):
"此率初如方程爲之，名各一逮井，其後法得七百二十一，實七十六，是爲七百二十一綆而七十六逮井，而戊一綆逮之數定，逮七百二十一分之七十六，是故七百二十一爲井深，七十六爲戊綆之長，舉率以言之"
% The column he describes is the last left standing, which holds 戊 and the 實: the left-hand column,
% after the 甲, 乙, 丙, 丁 positions have been cleared from it. (721 戊-ropes make 76 well-depths.)
Gives left 0 0 0 0 721 76     "其後法得七百二十一，實七十六"

name: dai-zhen-13
title: 8.13 (Dai Zhen, 訂訛)
words: 此問不言丈尺，無由知井深綆長於丈尺幾何，使井深半之，爲三丈六尺有半寸，則甲綆一丈三尺二寸半，乙綆九尺五寸半，丙綆七尺四寸，丁綆六尺四寸半，戊綆三尺八寸，使井深倍之，爲十四丈四尺二寸，則甲綆五丈三尺，乙綆三丈八尺二寸，丙綆二丈九尺六寸，丁綆二丈五尺八寸，戊綆一丈五尺二寸，皆合所問
text:
No. 8.13 (Dai Zhen, 訂訛)
% Sibu congkan pp. 43-45: Dai Zhen's collation notes (九章算術卷八訂訛) on Problem 13.
% He repeats the problem and answer (pp. 43-44; the figures are those of pp. 22-23) and adds, after the answer:
"此問不言丈尺，無由知井深綆長於丈尺幾何，使井深半之，爲三丈六尺有半寸，則甲綆一丈三尺二寸半，乙綆九尺五寸半，丙綆七尺四寸，丁綆六尺四寸半，戊綆三尺八寸，使井深倍之，爲十四丈四尺二寸，則甲綆五丈三尺，乙綆三丈八尺二寸，丙綆二丈九尺六寸，丁綆二丈五尺八寸，戊綆一丈五尺二寸，皆合所問"
% Half the depth, 360 1/2 cun, gives ropes 132 1/2, 95 1/2, 74, 64 1/2, 38 cun; double, 1442 cun, gives
% 530, 382, 296, 258, 152 cun. These are the text's figures halved and doubled; they are not figures of a
% board, and are kept as words. Both sets are in the ratio of the rates below.
"由是言之，問旣不定，以丈尺依術推求，先得七百二十一，無以定百爲丈十爲尺也，問井深綆長之率各幾何，荅以井深之率七百二十一，甲綆長率二百六十五，乙綆長率一百九十一，丙綆長率一百四十八，丁綆長率一百二十九，戊綆長率七十六，於義乃通"
% The board as the 術 sets it (see no-13): each column's 實 one depth.
Things 甲 乙 丙 丁 戊 實
Set right 2 1 0 0 0 1
Set 2nd   0 3 1 0 0 1
Set 3rd   0 0 4 1 0 1
Set 4th   0 0 0 5 1 1
Set left  1 0 0 0 6 1
Solve.
Rates 721 265 191 148 129 76    "荅以井深之率七百二十一，甲綆長率二百六十五……戊綆長率七十六"

% After Liu Hui's "此率初如方程爲之名各一逮井其後法得七百二十一實七十六" he writes (p. 45):
"此上訛舛不可通，據術先得七百二十一，爲所列五行之通率，卽井深率也，以此率列各行下，爲各行之下實，重求之，法得七百二十一，實得五萬四千七百九十六，以法除實，得用逮之數七十六"
% The board set again with 721 as every column's 下實 (以此率列各行下), and worked again (重求之).
Set right 2 1 0 0 0 721     "以此率列各行下，爲各行之下實"
Set 2nd   0 3 1 0 0 721
Set 3rd   0 0 4 1 0 721
Set 4th   0 0 0 5 1 721
Set left  1 0 0 0 6 721
Solve.                      "重求之"
Gives left 0 0 0 0 721 54796    "法得七百二十一，實得五萬四千七百九十六"
% 以法除實得用逮之數七十六: 54796 / 721 = 76, the 戊 rope. He states no figure for the other ropes,

name: no-14
words: 今有白禾二步，靑禾三步，黃禾四步，黑禾五步，實各不滿斗，白取靑黃，靑取黃黑，黃取黑白，黑取白靑各一步，而實滿斗，問白靑黃黑禾實一步各幾何

name: no-15
words: 今有甲禾二秉，乙禾三秉，丙禾四秉，重皆過於石，甲二重如乙一，乙三重如丙一，丙四重如甲一，問甲乙丙禾一秉各重幾何
text:
No. 8.15
% Sibu congkan pp. 25-26
"今有甲禾二秉，乙禾三秉，丙禾四秉，重皆過於石，甲二重如乙一，乙三重如丙一，丙四重如甲一，問甲乙丙禾一秉各重幾何"
% There are 2 bundles of grain A, 3 of B and 4 of C, each weighing more than a dan. The excess of A's two
% is as one of B; of B's three, as one of C; of C's four, as one of A. What does one bundle of each weigh?
"荅曰甲禾一秉重二十三分石之十七，乙禾一秉重二十三分石之十一，丙禾一秉重二十三分石之十"
% Answer: one bundle of A weighs 17/23 dan; of B, 11/23 dan; of C, 10/23 dan.
"術曰如方程置重過於石之物爲負"
"以正負術入之"
% Each condition is read: n bundles, less one bundle of the other grain (the excess), weigh one dan.
% The thing the excess is equal to (重過於石之物) is set negative, as the 術 says; the first condition
% (甲) is the right-hand column. Unit: the dan (石).
Things 甲禾 乙禾 丙禾 實
Set right   2 -1  0 1    "甲二重如乙一；置重過於石之物爲負"
Set middle  0  3 -1 1    "乙三重如丙一"
Set left   -1  0  4 1    "丙四重如甲一"
Solve.
Answer 17/23, 11/23, 10/23

% Liu Hui's commentary (pp. 25-26) explains the negative setting and the rule for entering the head
% positions; it states no figures:
"此問者言甲禾二秉之重過於一石也，其過者幾何，如乙一秉重矣，互其算，令相折除，以石爲之差實，差實者如甲禾餘實，故置算相與同也"
"此入頭位異名相除者，正無入正之，負無入負之也"

name: no-18
words: 今有麻九斗，麥七斗，菽三斗，荅二斗，黍五斗，直錢一百四十，麻七斗，麥六斗，菽四斗，荅五斗，黍三斗，直錢一百二十八，麻三斗，麥五斗，菽七斗，荅六斗，黍四斗，直錢一百一十六，麻二斗，麥五斗，菽三斗，答九斗，黍四斗，直錢一百一十二，麻一斗，麥三斗，菽二斗，荅八斗，黍五斗，直錢九十五，問一斗直幾何
text:

name: dai-zhen-18
title: 8.18 (Dai Zhen, 訂訛: 145 and 99)
words: 以上所言舊術訛舛不可通據方程術凡五物及總價求其各物之價者應列五行行五位及價以上一位互乘因徧乘次位以下及價兩兩相對減去其頭位所減之餘重列之減至一物一價乃止物爲法價爲實實如法而一得一物之價轉減而上以知各價
text:
No. 8.18 (Dai Zhen, 訂訛: 145 and 99)
% Sibu congkan pp. 48-49, Dai Zhen's collation notes on Liu Hui's commentary to Problem 18.
% He calls Liu Hui's account of the old method corrupt (訛舛不可通) and gives his own,
% with his own counts of 算.
"以上所言舊術訛舛不可通據方程術凡五物及總價求其各物之價者應列五行行五位及價以上一位互乘因徧乘次位以下及價兩兩相對減去其頭位所減之餘重列之減至一物一價乃止物爲法價爲實實如法而一得一物之價轉減而上以知各價"
% "What is said above of the old method is corrupt and cannot be followed. By the fangcheng
% procedure, to find each price from five things and their total prices, set five columns of
% five positions and the price; cross-multiply by the top positions, and so multiply through the
% positions below and the price; take each pair from the other to remove its head; set out again
% what is left; go on until one thing and one price remain. The thing is the 法, the price the 實;
% divide, and one price is found; work back upwards to know each price."
Things 麻 麥 菽 荅 黍 實
Set right 9 7 3 2 5 140
Set 2nd   7 6 4 5 3 128
Set 3rd   3 5 7 6 4 116
Set 4th   2 5 3 9 4 112
Set left  1 3 2 8 5  95
Solve by cross.
Answer 7, 4, 3, 5, 6
"先化五爲四次化四爲三次化三爲二次化二爲一凡用十算兼乘減除言之則一百四十五算"
% "First five become four, then four three, three two, two one: ten [eliminations] in all;
% counting multiplications, takings and divisions together, 145 算."
Count 145                                    "兼乘減除言之則一百四十五算"

"凡上一位互乘其數必同可省乘若遇上一位數同則省徧乘或上一位遇一則省其與對行徧乘"
% "After cross-multiplying, the heads are always equal, and need not be multiplied. Where the
% heads are equal, the multiplying through is saved; where a head is one, the multiplying
% through of the column against it is saved."
"考問意左行上一位是一先以左行減右行次減第二行次減第三行次減第四行所減之餘重列爲四行其左行上一位又是一以左行減右行次減第二行次減第三行所減之餘重列爲三行其上一位數皆同卽以本數減之餘列爲兩行依術得荅價轉而上求得菽價及麥價麻價凡用九十九算"
% "In this problem the left column's head is one: first take the left from the right, then from
% the 2nd, 3rd and 4th; set out what is left as four columns. Its left column's head is again one:
% take it from the right, the 2nd and the 3rd; set out what is left as three. Their heads are all
% equal: take them by the figures as they stand; set out what is left as two columns, and by the
% procedure find the price of 荅; work upwards for 菽, 麥 and 麻. In all, 99 算."
% Dai Zhen's arrangement keeps the column with a head of one on the left; `Solve by one` chooses
% it so. Dai Zhen does not say whether his 黍 (the last) is found before the 荅; it is found first here.
Set right 9 7 3 2 5 140
Set 2nd   7 6 4 5 3 128
Set 3rd   3 5 7 6 4 116
Set 4th   2 5 3 9 4 112
Set left  1 3 2 8 5  95
Solve by one.
Answer 7, 4, 3, 5, 6
Count 99                                     "凡用九十九算"

name: liu-hui-18-new
title: 8.18 (Liu Hui: the new method, 124 算)
words: 方程新術曰以正負術入之令左右相減先去下實又轉去物位求其一行二物正負相借者易其相當之率
text:
No. 8.18 (Liu Hui: the new method, 124 算)
% Sibu congkan pp. 31-35. Liu Hui's 方程新術 worked on Problem 18: the 實s are taken away first,
% so that each column says only that some things are worth others (相當之率), and the rates are
% read off two things at a time. He states four such pairs and, at the end, the count: 124 算.
% Dai Zhen (p. 50) calls this passage too corrupt to follow (亦訛舛不可通).
% 下位 is the 實 (the bottom position); 頭位 the head. 去 is read as until gone (直除); 減 as once,
% as far as it goes, or in turn (相減); 不足減乃止 as far as it goes. Where the text names a
% position for 減, it is used.
"方程新術曰以正負術入之令左右相減先去下實又轉去物位求其一行二物正負相借者易其相當之率"
% "The new method: by the rule of signs, take left and right from each other; first remove the
% 實s, then the things, to find a column of two things, one positive and one negative, and exchange
% them for the rates at which they are worth each other."
Things 麻 麥 菽 荅 黍 實
Set right 9 7 3 2 5 140
Set 2nd   7 6 4 5 3 128
Set 3rd   3 5 7 6 4 116
Set 4th   2 5 3 9 4 112
Set left  1 3 2 8 5  95
Take 4th from 3rd | Take 4th from 3rd as far as it goes | Take 4th from 3rd in turn   "以新術爲此先以第四行減第三行"
Take 3rd from right until 實 is gone | Nothing   "次以第三行去右行"
Take 3rd from 2nd until 實 is gone | Take 3rd from 2nd in turn until 實 is gone   "及第二行"
Take 3rd from 4th until 實 is gone | Take 3rd from 4th in turn until 實 is gone   "第四行下位"
Take 3rd from right as far as the 實 goes | Nothing   "又以減右行下位不足減乃止"
Take left from 3rd | Take left from 3rd as far as the 實 goes | Take left from 3rd in turn until 實 is gone   "次以左行減第三行下位"
Take 3rd from left until 實 is gone | Take 3rd from left in turn until 實 is gone   "次以第三行去左行下位"
Drop 3rd.                                    "訖廢去第三行"
Take 4th from left until 實 is gone | Take 4th from left in turn until 實 is gone   "次以第四行去左行下位"
"右行當左行下位"
% "the right stands against the left's bottom position": not an operation; kept as words.
Take right from 2nd until 實 is gone | Take right from 2nd in turn until 實 is gone   "次以右行去第二行"
Take right from 4th until 實 is gone | Take right from 4th in turn until 實 is gone   "及第四行下位"
Take 2nd from 4th | Take 2nd from 4th as far as it goes | Take 2nd from 4th in turn   "次以第二行減第四行"
Take 2nd from left | Take 2nd from left as far as it goes | Take 2nd from left in turn   "及左行願位"
% 願 is read as 頭 (head), as Dai Zhen reads it.
Take 4th from right as far as the 菽 goes   "次以第四行減右行菽位不足減乃止"
Take left from 2nd | Take left from 2nd as far as it goes | Take left from 2nd in turn   "次以左行減第二行頭位"
Halve 2nd.                                   "餘可再半"
Halve 2nd.
Take 4th from right until the head is gone | Take 4th from right in turn   "次以第四行去右行"
Take 4th from 2nd until the head is gone | Take 4th from 2nd in turn   "及第二行頭位"
Take 2nd from right until the head is gone | Take 2nd from right in turn   "次以第二行去右行頭位"
Reduce right.                                "餘約之"
Gives right 0 0 5 -3 0 0 | Gives right 0 0 -5 3 0 0   "上得五下得三是菽五當荅三"
% 菽 5 against 荅 3, the 實 gone.
% "Next with the left remove the 菽 of the 3rd": the 3rd was dropped above. Read as the 4th, or as nothing.
Take left from 4th until 菽 is gone | Nothing   "次以左行去第三行菽位"
Take left from 4th as far as the 菽 goes   "又以減第四行"
Take left from right as far as the 菽 goes   "及右行菽位不足減乃止"
Take right from 2nd as far as it goes   "次以右行減第二行頭位不足減乃止"
% "next with the 3rd remove the head of the left": the 3rd again. Read as the 4th, or nothing.
Take 4th from left until the head is gone | Nothing   "次以第三行去左行頭位"
Take left from right until the head is gone | Take left from right in turn   "次以左行去右行頭位"
Gives right 0 0 0 6 -5 0 | Gives right 0 0 0 -6 5 0   "餘上得六下得五是爲荅六當黍五"
Take right from left until 荅 is gone | Take right from left in turn until 荅 is gone   "次以右行去左行荅位"
Reduce left.                                 "餘約之上爲二下爲三"
% which two things are 2 and 3, it does not say.
Take left from 2nd until 實 is gone | Take left from 2nd in turn until 實 is gone   "次以左行去第二行下位"
Take 2nd from 4th until 實 is gone | Take 2nd from 4th in turn until 實 is gone   "以第二行去第四行下位"
Take 2nd from left as far as the 實 goes   "又以減左行下位"
Take right from 2nd until 實 is gone | Take right from 2nd in turn until 實 is gone   "次右行去第二行下位"
Gives 2nd 0 3 -4 0 0 0 | Gives 2nd 0 -3 4 0 0 0   "餘上得三下得四是爲麥三當菽四"
Take 2nd from 4th | Take 2nd from 4th as far as the 實 goes | Take 2nd from 4th in turn until 實 is gone   "次以第二行減第四行下位"
Take 4th from 2nd until 實 is gone | Take 4th from 2nd in turn until 實 is gone   "次以第四行去第二行下位"
Gives 2nd 4 -7 0 0 0 0 | Gives 2nd -4 7 0 0 0 0   "餘上得四下得七是爲麻四當麥七"
"是爲相當之率舉矣據麻四當麥七卽爲麻價率七而麥價率四又麥三當菽四卽爲麥價率四而菽價率三又荅六當黍五卽爲荅價率五而黍價率六而率通矣"
% "So the rates at which things are worth each other are all found: 麻 4 for 麥 7 gives the rates
% 麻 7, 麥 4; 麥 3 for 菽 4, 麥 4, 菽 3; 荅 6 for 黍 5, 荅 5, 黍 6: the rates agree." They are the prices.
"如此則凡用一百二十四算也"
% The last part of the method, from 更置第三行, is on the page liu-hui-18-rates.
% "This way uses 124 算 in all." (p. 35) Not compared: no reading of the ratio-finding gets through it.

% "next with the left remove the head of the 4th and the 2nd;"

Take left from 2nd | Take left from 2nd until the head is gone | Take left from 2nd as far as it goes | Take left from 2nd in turn | Take left from 2nd crosswise   "及第二行頭位"

Gives 3rd 1 0 4 -3 0 4                       "餘有麻一斗菽四斗荅三斗負下實四正"
"求其同爲麻之數以菽率三荅率五各乘菽荅斗數如麻率七而一菽得一斗七分斗之五正荅得二斗七分斗之一負則菽荅化爲麻以并之令同名相從異名相消餘爲定麻七分斗之四以爲法置下實四爲實以分母乘之實得二十八而分子化爲法矣以法除得七卽麻一斗之價"
